title: admsc-palmitate-8oxoG-methylation: analysis code for nanopore 5mC/5hmC and 8-oxo-dG profiling of palmitate-treated human adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells
description: Analysis code supporting the article "Lipotoxic Palmitate Hyperpolarizes Mitochondria, Raises 8-oxo-dG Damage in Depleted mtDNA, and Converts Nuclear 5mC to 5hmC Genome-Wide in Human Adipose-Derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells" (International Journal of Molecular Sciences, submitted 2026): basecalling and conversion of Oxford Nanopore R9.4.1 data (Guppy/Rerio, dorado, esox, modkit, minimap2), pooled 5mC and 5mC/5hmC estimation, 8-oxo-dG rates, 5mC around 8-oxo-dG, figure code and the image analysis of the mitochondrial network (Nellie, Cellpose). Processed data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23111729; images: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23112401.
